summary.text: Ramon Perez is a Democratic member of the Rhode Island House of Representatives, representing District 13 since January 5, 2021, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Republican Derick Reels. He is a business owner.

paragraphs.text: Ramon Perez's career experience includes owning New England Taxi.
In the 2021-2022 session he was assigned to the Small Business and Special Legislation committees.
